correctness.rationale: The full Baker--Cohen--Dam--Felber--Madras--Saha--Thackrah paper gives exact even- and odd-crossing binomial-column sums for \(s(c,2n)\), the exact size of the partially doubled model \(T(c)\), and the palindromic correction transferring to \(K(c)\). After normalization, the even formula is a geometric mixture with asymptotic weights \((3/4)4^{-i}\) of centered binomial point masses; the odd formula has the same structure with a half-step center shift and an exponentially remote truncation. Uniform local De Moivre--Laplace on \(|n|=O(\sqrt c)\), geometric domination of fixed/medium mixture indices, and an exponentially small tail give the claimed local limit. The palindromic correction is exponentially smaller than \(c^{-1/2}\), so the same local limit holds for \(K(c)\). The lattice span two explains the prefactor 2.
correctness.risk: The result is a central-window local theorem only; it does not claim a uniform local approximation into moderate or large deviations.

final_claim: For every fixed \(A>0\), uniformly over even signatures \(|\sigma|\le A\sqrt c\), the signature point mass among \(c\)-crossing 2-bridge knots satisfies \(k(c,\sigma)/|K(c)|=(2/\sqrt c)\phi(\sigma/\sqrt c)+o(c^{-1/2})\). In particular every fixed even signature has asymptotic proportion \(\sqrt{2/(\pi c)}\) and count asymptotic \((2^{c-3}/3)\sqrt{2/(\pi c)}\).
limitations: Only even signatures occur and the stated uniformity is restricted to \(|\sigma|\le A\sqrt c\) for fixed \(A\).
